findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice short questions for Unit 9 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 52 questions numbered 1-52; by section: 9.1 4, 9.1.1 6, 9.1.2 5, 9.1.3 5, 9.1.4 4, 9.1.5 4, 9.1.6 15, 9.2 9.

Covers 9.1, 9.1.1-9.1.6 and 9.2 in book order: definitions of the principal functions and their inverses, domains and ranges, principal values, graphs and asymptotes, inside-out evaluation, domains of composite functions, the relations of Examples 4-6, half-angle values, and the sum, difference and double formulas with their conditions, all with new values. Book corrections followed (closed brackets for the csc/sec ranges, cos(a + b) with minus, cot^-1 x = tan^-1(1/x) only for x > 0, cos^-1 x = sin^-1 sqrt(1 - x^2) only for 0 <= x <= 1). Every answer was checked numerically (check9.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
